chapter: Brother Burnell and learning to read
title: Brothers and sisters, Burnell and learning at home
summary: Birth order of siblings, Burnell's piano playing from age 12, and their mother correcting wrong notes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What about your family? I wanted to get your brothers and sisters straight. Is Chani young?
Yeah, Chani's the baby. The baby girl. That's John Brunner's wife, the trumpet man.
Uh-huh. What year was Burnell born in about?
Burnell? Burnell was born in about 1915, around during the time of the storm. Burnell was born in about 1915.
And he wasn't even to play piano.
He was in his blood and he made a wonderful piano player. How young did he start? When he was a little kid? Oh yeah, much younger than me.
When he was around 12 years old, he was playing fine piano at that time.
He was around 12 years old. He was playing fine piano at that time.
You always had a piano at home to practice on?
Always had, yeah. My mother had an organ and a piano.
Did she ever help the children with the music sound?
Yeah, she would be doing her work in the kitchen, and if you made a bad note, she'd call you attention to it. She'd stop you and correct you.
Did you learn to read right away when you started in music?
